SUMMARY: Epic 17 - Auth, offline and small gaps
DESCRIPTION: Small gaps the phase 10 and phase 11 retros recorded and no ticket owns: a swallowed Google sign-in error, the offline add form, skeleton and layout-shift leftovers, one dark frame on load, and the Home fold. Phases and the decision register are in epics-15-19-build-order.md.

SUMMARY: Google sign-in shows the error when the OAuth start fails
USER_STORY: As a user, I want to be told when Google sign-in did not start, so I am not left with a button that does nothing.
DESCRIPTION: `signInWithGoogle` (src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx:96) awaits `signInWithOAuth` and ignores the result; LoginPage.tsx:40 calls it. Found by LED-144 (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-led-144-login.md) and the phase 10 retro (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-epics-8-13-phase-10-design-parity.md). Observed: After a failed start the button just re-enables. AGENTS.md: auth failures are shown to the user. Suggested fix: Read `error`, map it through `src/lib/authErrors.ts` and surface it the way `authError` already is; keep the button disabled while the redirect starts.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) A blocked OAuth start shows a plain-language message on Login; (b) the button re-enables; (c) a unit test for the error mapping; (d) checked with the request blocked; (e) LED-162 (sign-out copy) is not changed.

SUMMARY: The offline add form picks an account from the cache
USER_STORY: As an offline user, I want the add form to know my accounts, so I can queue an entry without a blank account.
DESCRIPTION: The add form (src/components/transactions/TransactionForm.tsx and its account source). Found by LED-145 (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-led-145-home-pay-now.md) and the phase 10 retro (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-epics-8-13-phase-10-design-parity.md). Observed: Offline, the form opens with "Select account" and USD until the cached accounts arrive, so the user must pick an account. Not caused by LED-145. Suggested fix: Read the cached accounts synchronously when offline and default to the last-used account; LED-153 (Won't Do, OD-6 (c)) means the old `ledger-last-account:<user>` key stays unread, so pick the first account only if there is exactly one.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) Offline with a cache, the form opens with an account and its currency once the cache is read, and never shows "Select account" with accounts available; (b) an empty cache still shows the empty state; (c) checked with the network blocked; (d) no change while online.

SUMMARY: Deleting a saved filter offers Undo
USER_STORY: As a user, I want to undo a deleted saved filter, so a mis-click does not lose it.
DESCRIPTION: The saved-filters dialog and hook added by LED-138 (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-led-138-saved-filters.md). Observed: Deleting asks nothing and offers no Undo. Suggested fix: Use the existing Undo notification pattern (LED-93 notification surface) rather than a confirm dialog.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) Deleting shows an Undo that restores the filter with its original order; (b) after the notice goes, the filter is gone; (c) a failed delete or restore is shown, not swallowed; (d) works from the palette group and the Activity dialog.

SUMMARY: The first-run checklist reserves its space
USER_STORY: As a new user, I want Home to stay still while it loads, so nothing jumps under my finger.
DESCRIPTION: src/components/dashboard (first-run checklist). Found by LED-150 (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-led-150-skeletons.md) and the phase 11 retro (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-epics-8-13-phase-11-a11y-density-skeletons-theme.md). Observed: The checklist appears only after load and moves everything down 362px. It was not on the LED-150 list. Note LED-158 (epic 14) fixes its step 2 at 390; do not repeat that. Suggested fix: Decide visibility from cached profile data before first paint, or reserve the height with a skeleton the same size.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) Home's layout shift on load is under 1px at 1280 and 390 for a user who sees the checklist and one who does not; (b) measured before and after in the retro; (c) `loading-states.md` followed; (d) no change for a user who dismissed it.

SUMMARY: Skeleton leftovers: net worth note, forecast items, loan tracker, Liabilities column, light theme
USER_STORY: As a user, I want the remaining loading states to match the loaded layout, so nothing shifts.
DESCRIPTION: Found by LED-150 (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-led-150-skeletons.md). Observed: The net worth note (139 against 163) and the forecast's recurring items are data-dependent and not reserved. The loan purchase tracker, and the Categories subcategory, rules and Unused skeletons, were not measured (nothing was seeded). The Liabilities column skeleton is drawn as three asset-style rows; liability cards are taller. Light theme skeletons were not looked at. Suggested fix: Seed the data, measure each, and adjust the skeleton heights.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) Each named site is measured loaded and loading and the difference is under 4px; (b) the Liabilities skeleton matches a loan and a card; (c) the light theme is viewed; (d) the numbers are in the retro.

SUMMARY: No dark frame on load for a System-theme user
USER_STORY: As a System-theme user on a light OS, I want the first paint to be light, so the page does not flash.
DESCRIPTION: The theme is applied in an effect (src/index.css tokens, the theme provider). Found by LED-151 (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-led-151-theme-leftovers.md) and the phase 11 retro (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-epics-8-13-phase-11-a11y-density-skeletons-theme.md). Observed: There is no pre-paint script and the CSP allows only `script-src 'self'`, so a System user on a light OS may see one dark frame; a stored light theme had the same problem. Suggested fix: A small first-party file loaded from `index.html` (allowed by `'self'`, no CSP change) that sets the class and `meta theme-color` before paint. Not a `unsafe-inline` script.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) A System user on a light OS sees no dark frame (recorded with a screenshot at first paint); (b) a stored dark or light theme paints correctly; (c) the CSP strings in `index.html` and `vercel.json` are unchanged; (d) `meta theme-color` follows the theme; (e) a test that reads the file for the theme keys.

SUMMARY: First four widgets above the fold at 390
USER_STORY: As a phone user, I want the first four Home widgets visible without scrolling, as the design says.
DESCRIPTION: Home widget grid (src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx). Found by LED-145 (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-led-145-home-pay-now.md) and the phase 10 retro (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-epics-8-13-phase-10-design-parity.md). Observed: "First four widgets above the fold" cannot be met at 390x844. LED-134 set the default order only. Options: (a) a shorter cash flow chart on phones; (b) fewer widgets above it; (c) drop the claim from the ticket and design note. Recommendation: (a). This is OD-11. Fallback: as is, and the claim is recorded as not met. Decision (2026-10-03, OD-11): (a), a shorter cash flow chart on phones.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) OD-11 answered in the decision register; (b) at 390x844 the answer holds (measured); (c) the desktop layout does not change; (d) a customised widget order is unaffected.

SUMMARY: Home ranked card against the pie card at 1920 and with a custom widget order
USER_STORY: As a user, I want Home cards in a row to line up, so the grid looks intentional.
DESCRIPTION: Home widget grid. Found by LED-149 (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-led-149-density-leftovers.md). Observed: The ranked card is taller than the pie card in its grid row. It was not checked against the grid at 1920 or with a customised widget order. Suggested fix: Measure both, then set the row so the shorter card stretches, or cap the ranked card with "Show more".
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) At 1920, 1280 and 390 the row heights match or the difference is intended and recorded; (b) a reordered layout is checked; (c) the numbers are in the retro.

SUMMARY: Net worth chart x labels are cramped at 390
USER_STORY: As a phone user, I want the x labels readable, so months do not run together.
DESCRIPTION: The net worth chart in src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx. Found by the live sweep (knowledge/retros/2026-09-26-live-sweep-lists-reports-import.md). Observed: At 390 the labels ("Mar Apr", "Jun Jul") sit close together. Suggested fix: Show every other tick below `sm`, using the tick helper LED-174 adds.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) At 390 no two labels are closer than 8px; (b) at 1280 the chart is unchanged; (c) covered by the same tick-helper test as LED-174.
